content.short: Transpose provides real-time access to high-level blockchain data via REST and SQL APIs.
content.description: Transpose is a blockchain data indexing and integration platform built for developers. It lets you run flexible, low-latency queries against real-time data across networks via SQL and REST APIs. Founded in December 2021 by Alex Langshur and Michael Calvey, Transpose provides flexible integration options that help reduce infrastructure costs and speed up time to market. Hundreds of companies rely on Transpose for mission-critical data tasks—from tax and compliance data tied to historical activity to wallet analytics, segmentation, and powering reactive frontends with real-time balance and price data.
